body: I'd avoid all this `front()->get()` stuff by just doing `Node *selected_node = selection.front()->get()` once.

Is there a way to have only the `(parent)` option added? (aside from the unsaved bug)
Inherited scene is always an instance.

Could you elaborate on the desired behaviour?

This PR's implemented behaviour:
1. All scene instances have a "Show in FileSystem" option that shows the parent scene.
2. All scene roots have a "Show in FileSystem" option that shows the current scene, except if the scene is `[unsaved](*)`.
3. If (1) and (2) overlap (an inherited scene root, which is also a scene instance), (1) shows up as "Show in FileSystem (parent)" while (2) stays as "Show in FileSystem". If unsaved, (1) shows up as "Show in FileSystem (parent)" while (2) is not available.

> All scene roots have a "Show in FileSystem" option that shows the current scene, except if the scene is [unsaved](*).

Ah, I thought #119638 would fix this. I think the new option should always show together with the regular "Show in FileSystem", because unsaved inherited scene is technically still an instance. The current behavior is a bug IMO.

> I think the new option should always show together with the regular "Show in FileSystem", because unsaved inherited scene is technically still an instance.

So you mean that the unsaved inherited scene root should have "Show in FileSystem" instead of "Show in FileSystem (parent)", and it should show the parent scene (as "Show in FileSystem (parent)" currently does)?

Or do you mean it should use "TOOL_SHOW_IN_FILE_SYSTEM" instead of "TOOL_SHOW_IN_FILE_SYSTEM_INHERITED" on an unsaved inherited scene root?

> So you mean that the unsaved inherited scene root should have "Show in FileSystem" instead of "Show in FileSystem (parent)"

No, it should have both.

> No, it should have both. And both options should show the parent scene? I am very confused... If the current scene is `[unsaved](*)`, then the current scene does not yet exist in the FileSystem as a `.tscn` file, so showing the current scene is not possible. If the current scene is `scene_name(*)`, i.e. edited but changes not saved, then both options are available. One of them shows the parent scene, and the other shows the current scene.

Ah right, unsaved scene does not exist in FileSystem yet .-.
Nevermind then.
